items.title: Industry Continues to Push Back on HIPAA Security Rule Overhaul
items.description: Healthcare cyberattacks are on the rise, but industry organizations say the proposed changes to the security rules fall short of what's needed.

items.title: ServiceNow Buys Armis for $7.75B, Gets 'AI Control Tower'
items.description: Its latest cybersecurity acquisition will help further ServiceNow's plans for autonomous cybersecurity, and building a security stack to proactively manage AI.
